runtime.timing_definition: synchronized fixed-bank simulation plus exact prefix evaluation and final sampling; excludes publishing; offline PCA fit separately

settings.seed_schedule: blocked100; stable index in immutable split

evaluation_dataset.source: external evaluation only; no fit or retuning
evaluation_dataset.preprocessing: native grayscale PNG L /255; explicit template dimensions
evaluation_dataset.physics_rule: Use frozen final.yaml optics; dataset pitch metadata does not override system calibration

optics.boundary: circular FFT convolution; normalized intensity PSF; no padding
optics.kernel_precision: reference float32 frequencies / complex64 transfer and impulse; intensity promoted to float64 before normalization
optics.measurement: actual complementary uint8 exposures; difference / sqrt(d); sensor noise per settings.sensor_noise (none when sigma_rel=0)
optics.limitations: incoherent DMD-plane assumption; not validated coherent laser optics; periodic wraparound; no absolute watts

sensor_noise.definition: per exposure S±+n±, n±~N(0,(sigma_rel*S_ref)²) independent; dark offset cancels in the complementary difference; y noise std sqrt(2)*sigma_d/sqrt(d)
sensor_noise.seed_rule: torch.Generator seed = seed*1000003 + image_index*100003 + effective row index; independent of selected codes
sensor_noise.method_awareness: none: selection, projection, pinv and samplers are unchanged and treat y as exact

pattern_pool.definition: Training-only centered PCA variance order; no Walsh prefix or online design

metadata.definition: Centered natural-image PCA, descending variance; all rows predetermined before test observations

preprocessing.resize: PIL LANCZOS 256 to 512, uint8 grayscale /255; no native 512 training detail

metadata.pca_center: empirical mean of all training images; decoder mean unchanged
metadata.algorithm: CPU-block streamed randomized subspace SVD; approximate top components
metadata.selection: max mean physical-row cosine with PCA direction, per predetermined block; no Q/current measurements

fixed_bank_execution.rule: all codes presealed; prefix metrics use exact nested unpivoted QR; no future y in prefix reconstructions
fixed_bank_execution.prefix_times: offline evaluation times, not incremental hardware timings

numerics.rank_policy: full rank; no truncation, regularization or damping
numerics.condition_definition: full A condition bounds every prefix condition

patterns.id_definition: offline_pca:i indexes the immutable training-only PCA bank; RMS is zero relative to that bank
patterns.includes_prefix: First prefix_count rows are the executed initial prefix; no separate fixed result

ssim_definition: ProxUnroll: clamp recon [0,1], x255, skimage structural_similarity data_range=255 defaults (7x7 uniform, sample cov)
psnr_definition: psnr unclipped physical; psnr_clamped = recon clamped to [0,1] (ProxUnroll)
retention: No O/F, candidates, optimizer states, GT arrays, reconstruction arrays or other strategies saved. Simulation rerun required after interruption; no hardware resume claim.

information_capture.projector: P_A = Q Q^T; A^T = Q R is thin QR of actual uint8-complement effective rows
information_capture.domain: full physical measurement canvas; x and mu are physical intensities in [0,1]
information_capture.association: centered full pseudoinverse; offline GT-only evaluation, never supplied to selection
